text: Marinesco-Sjögren syndrome (MSS; OMIM 248800) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder with onset in early infancy, causing mainly cerebellar ataxia, progressive myopathy, cataracts and intellectual disability [ 1 ]. Approximately 60% of MSS patients carry homozygous or compound heterozygous SIL1 variants that make the SIL1 protein metabolically unstable, eventually leading to its loss [ 2 – 4 ].
source_label: Trazodone, dibenzoylmethane and tauroursodeoxycholic acid do not prevent motor dysfunction and neurodegeneration in Marinesco-Sjögren syndrome mice
